received_works.body:
Thank you, Mr. Happaman, for opening a skeb request.
We have sent you a request to draw a proxy character for our Twitter icon.
I would like to use your illustration as an icon for Twitter/discord/YouTube, etc.
The size of the character is large and the clothing design is up to you.
I like to drink alcohol, so I would be happy if the illustration looks like a scene during an evening drink.
Thank you in advance.

https://x.com/poyochaaaaaan/status/1596780496272248832?s=46&t=6TQ91A_WnPFIPesjj3B5xA

Thank you for releasing SkevriQuest.
I would like to request another illustration from you, so I sent you a message.

Regarding the details of the request,
I would like you to draw a deputy who was previously commissioned by @microwave0517, this time with the theme of "travel".
In addition to the theme, I have a few other requests this time.

Bag
I would like her to wear a slightly larger travel bag.

Goods
We would like you to attach Efyuan goods (including Bokutabi, Zettoku, etc.) to your bag and other personal belongings. Whether or not they are existing items is up to you.

Clothes
Clothes should be suitable for travel or travel-like clothes as imagined by Happaman.

Composition
We would like to see the whole body of the person in the photo.

Signature
We would like you to write your signature in a large size!

Other details such as facial expressions and detailed composition are left up to us.

We would like to use your illustration as an icon for social networking sites.
Thank you very much!

Thank you for accepting my new request!
I have sent you a message to make a request.

I would like to ask you to draw an illustration of a surrogate character that you have previously drawn for me.
I love to eat, so I would be happy if you could draw me eating something while surrounded by food.
The size can be either large or small. It is up to you. I would be happy if she wears the dress shown on the first page.

We would like to use your illustration as an icon, header, etc.
Thank you very much.

https://twitter.com/fluorite_yan/status/1665391160460988416?s=46&t=Ti-c4hoeebmogrdaZ2sCWg

Thank you for opening the skeb request!

I would like to send a message to Mr. Happerman to request this service!

I have previously requested a proxy for @Hpllp_hykmsk's Twitter account, but I would like a composition of a sleeping chick clinging to a pillow, with a larger life size and as full an image as possible, but I would like to leave it to you to decide on the expression and angle of the sleeping chick or if it is hidden by the pillow. I would be happy to have a full image if possible, but I would like to leave it up to you.

I would like to use your illustration as an icon, etc.
Thank you in advance!

Hello Mr. Weppermann. I have enjoyed watching your videos for a long time.
I sent you a request to request you to release a Skeb request.

I would like you to draw a deputy in the style of Mr. Happaman.

I would be happy if you could draw her in the motif of music game (BEMANI series), such as clothes, decoration, and personal belongings, since my hobby is music game.
I plan to use the illustrations I receive for my personal enjoyment and as social networking icons.

I know this is an unfamiliar genre, but I would appreciate your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xs02M5EahlmmgWmnTX_75jamv1cYF8hd/view?usp=share_link

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xs02M5EahlmmgWmnTX_75jamv1cYF8hd/view?usp=share_link

We would like you to draw an image character to be used as an icon.

The image color is purple
A woman who likes sports and kimonos.
She is meticulous in an odd way, but basically rough around the edges.
She also likes cats, plants, and books.
Dislikes tidying up
Afraid of big dogs and snakes

I don't really know what kind of things to write about, it's very abstract, but thank you!

Thank you for releasing the skeb request.
I would like to request a character to be used for icons on twitter, discord, etc. This is my first request for skeb, so there may be some flaws in it.

Regarding the content of your request, I don't have any proxy characters or other materials, is it possible to make a request?

If so, please let me know,
Size→Large
Glasses→Boston type
Hair color→Black base color
Hair color→Black based color ・Hair style→We will send you an illustration close to the image as a reference material.
Clothes→Pants
We would like you to draw the current icon without using it as a reference.
We would like you to draw it without referring to the current icon.

We would like you to draw the above features.
We will leave the rest of the composition up to you, but we would appreciate it if you could write your signature in a larger size.

https://twitter.com/microwave0517/status/1656990935333621760?t=RleknU2R3mNu0r3PqkAYng&s=09

Hi Dr. Happaman, my name is Hayama. I always enjoy looking at your illustrations.
Thank you for starting to accept requests.
I would like to make a request immediately. This is the first time for me to make a request, so I apologize if it is incomplete.

The height of the figure is high, the clothes are black suit, and the composition is up to you.

I would be happy to use your illustration for my Twitter icon and header.

Thank you very much in advance.

Thank you for opening Skeb!
I am contacting Dr. Happaman to ask him to create an illustration of a surrogate for use on a social networking site.

We would like her to be large (high) in height, without cat ears and tail, but we will leave the composition, pose, and clothing up to you.

If possible, it would be great if you could have two cats (see reference) somewhere...

Thank you in advance!

Thank you for accepting my new request!
I have sent you a message to make a request.

I would like to ask you to draw an illustration of a surrogate character that you have previously drawn for me.
I would like to ask you to draw the character in a larger scale, and I would like the composition to look like she is lying down in her loungewear, holding a controller and playing a game, with a loose atmosphere.

We would like to use your illustration as an icon or header.
Thank you in advance.

https://twitter.com/fluorite_yan/status/1624554683414233088?s=46&t=EFEbThrdFCqoLAHi5GrqAA

Thank you for opening Skeb.
Thank you very much for opening the Skeb. I was told that you could draw an original character for us, and I wanted to see our child drawn in your style.
I am sorry to say that there are 25 characters, but I would like to ask Mr. Happaman to draw the character that he would like to draw the most.
I have placed the related cartoons in the "Works based on" section, but since I know you have time on your hands, you can just go by the looks of the characters!
I would like to draw the characters using their supernatural powers, and if possible, I would like to see them using them! I would appreciate it if you could draw them as they are using their supernatural powers!
I do not intend to use your illustrations as icons, but I will treasure them forever!

The original worldview is here.
→https://shindanmaker.com/264162
→http://allegro.tudura.com/inou.html

Nice to meet you, my name is Rionu.
Thank you for opening skeb request. I sent you a message to request this service.

■Request
　I would like you to draw an original character that I usually use for my icons. I will leave the pose and composition to you.

■Resources
https://twitter.com/nemumimaru_10/status/1624577810009591808?s=46&t=Q9iNZDAMHTVF8_hN7ssmeQ

We apologize for the lightweight material, not the easy-to-understand material such as three-view plan.
We apologize for the lightness of the material.
She wears a white shirt and a yellow-green skirt with a belt, with a calm look like office fashion.
She wears earrings in her ears, one on the right and two on the left. She also wears nail polish on her hands.

Usage
I would like to use the illustration for a social networking icon and Discord icon.

Thank you very much in advance.

Thank you for opening skeb!
My name is Sakri!
I sent you a message to make a request!
I don't know how to write a message, so I'm writing it while referring to other people.
I'm sorry if the sentences are similar.

Is it possible to ask you to draw an illustration of a surrogate character for a Twitter icon?
I would like it to be large in size, with the hands out, and I will leave everything else to you, including the composition.
My hobby is video editing, so I would be happy if you could include tools such as a PC in the illustration.

I would like to use your illustrations for icons and other purposes.
If possible, I would like to use it as a 2D drawing for my own use at work.
I would appreciate it if you could dress it appropriately.

https://twitter.com/game__focus/status/1596837413808050176?s=20&t=p4TsOFnv1tK7i2uja89YZw

Thank you very much in advance.

Thank you for opening a new skeb request!
I would like to request that Mr. Happaman draw our child (proxy) "Momochiru".
I would like to use your illustration as an icon for my Twitter account (@momochiru___45) and SNS icons such as Discord.
I will leave the pose and composition to you.
(Costume note: Hair is clipped at the back on both sides.)
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

I always enjoy watching your delivery.
I would like to send you a request for a Twitter icon illustration.
I am sorry that it is not a proxy but a portrait illustration, but I hope you will accept my request.
The original illustration is more realistic, but I would be very happy if you could draw it in the style of Happaman.
Her hair is gray and she has a mole around her mouth.
I would be happy if she wears a long green skirt underneath.
I would be happy if you could provide me with opera glasses, tickets, etc., as I love the stage.
Thank you very much.
I will continue to support you.
